newsitem.title: JAPAN: TEPCO to start leasing grid to private firms.
newsitem.headline: TEPCO to start leasing grid to private firms.

text.p: Tokyo Electric Power Co Inc (TEPCO) said on Friday it will start leasing its power grid to private firms from April after a government decision to lift restrictions on the leasing.
Companies other than power utilities with their own generators can now send surplus electricity to their factories and offices in different locations, using TEPCO's power grid.

TEPCO will charge 3.95 yen per one kilowatt-hour sent through its grid, a company spokesman said. Steel firms and oil refiners, most of which already have their own power generators, are expected to utilise the new arrangement, he said.
Several other Japanese electric power companies are planning similar moves.
